story_zh: 在法院，双方出示证据。法官确认事实后，承认合同成立。一方违反规则，必须承担罚款。另一方受伤，获得赔偿。法官谨慎处理，制定公平措施。双方遵守法律，确认结论。这属于合法程序，保障权利平等。
story_pinyin: Zài fǎyuàn, shuāngfāng chūshì zhèngjù. Fǎguān quèrèn shìshí hòu, chéngrèn hétóng chénglì. Yīfāng wéifǎn guīzé, bìxū chéngdān fákuǎn. Lìng yīfāng shòushāng, huòdé péicháng. Fǎguān jǐnshèn chǔlǐ, zhìdìng gōngpíng cuòshī. Shuāngfāng zūnshǒu fǎlǜ, quèrèn jiélùn. Zhè shǔyú héfǎ chéngxù, bǎozhàng quánlì píngděng.
story_en: In court, both sides present evidence. After confirming the facts, the judge recognizes the contract as established. One party violated the rules and must bear a fine. The other party was injured and receives compensation. The judge handles the case cautiously and formulates fair measures. Both sides comply with the law and confirm the conclusion. This belongs to a legal procedure, ensuring equal rights.
